instruction: Format the lesson plan according to the formatting requirements shown in the image.

dim1: The deliverable is a Microsoft Word file in .doc or .docx format, and the file opens properly.
The delivered document has no 2 or more consecutive blank pages, no garbled text covering more than 1/3 of a page, and no overlapping text covering more than 1/3 of a page.
The titles, paragraphs, design intent, assignment design, and teaching reflection text in the delivered document are all editable; the entire document must not be converted into images or a PDF.
dim2: +3: The page size is A4 in portrait orientation, with margins set to 2.6 cm at the top, 2.6 cm at the bottom, 2.4 cm on the left, and 2.4 cm on the right.

+1: The lesson plan title “Teaching Case: ‘A Brief Appreciation of Classical Chinese Narratives and Understanding Principles for Conducting Oneself’” uses the Heiti font, Small 2 size, and bold formatting.

+1: The paragraph containing the lesson plan title “Teaching Case: ‘A Brief Appreciation of Classical Chinese Narratives and Understanding Principles for Conducting Oneself’” is center-aligned with 38 pt line spacing.

+5: The major section headings “Teaching Material Analysis,” “Student Analysis,” “Design Philosophy,” “Teaching Objectives,” “Key and Difficult Teaching Points,” “Teaching Preparation,” “Lesson Schedule,” “Explanation of the Teaching Approach,” “Teaching Process,” “Blackboard Design,” “Assignment Design,” and “Teaching Reflection” all use the Heiti font, Small 4 size, and no bold formatting.

+3: The major section headings “Teaching Material Analysis,” “Student Analysis,” “Design Philosophy,” “Teaching Objectives,” “Key and Difficult Teaching Points,” “Teaching Preparation,” “Lesson Schedule,” “Explanation of the Teaching Approach,” “Teaching Process,” “Blackboard Design,” “Assignment Design,” and “Teaching Reflection” are all flush left, with no indentation applied.
+3: The first-level headings in the Teaching Process section (numbered with the Chinese numerals for one, two, three, …) use the Heiti font, Small 4 size, and no bold formatting.
+3: The first-level heading paragraphs in the Teaching Process section are not flush left and have a first-line indent of two characters.

+3: The second-level headings in the Teaching Process section (such as those numbered with parenthesized Chinese numerals for one, two, three, …) use the Heiti font, Small 4 size, and no bold formatting.
+3: The second-level heading paragraphs in the Teaching Process section are not flush left and have a first-line indent of two characters.
+3: The third-level headings in the Teaching Process section (such as “1.”, “2.”, “3.”…) use the Songti font, Small 4 size, and bold formatting.
+5: All text other than headings uses the Songti font in Small 4 size.
+5: All text other than headings uses 1.5 line spacing, a first-line indent of 2 characters, and either justified or left alignment.
-3: The objective numbering under the “Teaching Objectives” section is not in the “1.”, “2.”, “3.” format.
-5: Half-width square brackets appear in the document.

-3: Any of the major section headings “Teaching Material Analysis,” “Student Analysis,” “Design Philosophy,” “Teaching Objectives,” “Key and Difficult Teaching Points,” “Teaching Preparation,” “Lesson Schedule,” “Explanation of the Teaching Approach,” “Teaching Process,” “Blackboard Design,” “Assignment Design,” and “Teaching Reflection” is not on a separate line, or non-heading text appears on the same line as a heading.
